Our story began in 2016, when a group of finance professionals started supporting the operational needs of other organizations under the name BFS – Business & Finance Solutions. Over the years, we earned the trust of clients and candidates across a wide range of sectors by ensuring continuity and results. This journey strengthened our ambition to affirm our position in the industry and in people’s minds. Today, we are proud to continue that story as Proffinco. The new name reflects our identity as professionals in finance and control, and the brand itself symbolizes our evolution. We are YOUR United Forces in Finance.
